name: Symbio Smoke Suite
description: Minimal regression checks for tool planning and response quality.

cases.name: Plans a documentation lookup
cases.description: The agent should identify that documentation lookup needs a browser fetch style tool.
cases.input_text: Find the latest project documentation and summarize the deployment steps.

cases.name: Returns an actionable answer
cases.description: The response should be structured and useful enough for an operator.
cases.input_text: Summarize the current execution status and list the next verification steps.
cases.expected_output: Status summary with concrete verification steps.
